answer: Each identity locks a 75-credit tributary bond before drawing from the shared river. The bond funds one tributary project, verified by a zephyr auditor who checks key-bound completion proof. The finished project enters the tundra ledger, frozen against reuse, so one project cannot activate two identities. The kth fake still needs its own 75-credit bond and project, so 1,000 fakes lock 75,000 credits and must finish 1,000 projects, with no bulk discount. A rented project fails: the auditor matches completion key to applicant key and burns 30 credits on mismatch. An honest agent pays once.
